overview: The Historic District Commission approved prior meeting minutes and postponed a scheduled public hearing to November 9 due to pamphlet mailing delays. Commissioners also deferred discussion on a property inquiry for 20 Hillside and noted an upcoming member resignation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted to accept two sets of prior meeting minutes.

items.title: 20 Hillside Work Inquiry
items.summary: Discussion of proposed aluminum gutters and porch shingles at 20 Hillside was postponed to the next meeting pending a formal application.

items.title: Public Hearing Postponement
items.summary: The commission postponed its upcoming public hearing to November 9 at 6:00 p.m. in the City Council Chamber due to printing and mailing delays.

items.title: Commission Administration and Updates
items.summary: Commissioners noted the anticipated resignation of member Chris Donovan and briefly discussed pamphlet design choices and access to meeting recordings.
